name: Reported statements
summary: Birovning so'zlarini o'zgartirib, boshqasiga aytib berish uchun ishlatiladi. Bunda zamonlar orqaga suriladi.

usage.text: Birovning aytgan gapini o'tgan zamonda boshqasiga yetkazish uchun qo'llaniladi.

example.en: He said that he lived in London.

usage.text: Present Simple zamonidagi gapni Past Simple ga o'zgartirish uchun.
Present Continuous zamonini Past Continuous ga o'tkazish uchun.

example.en: Tom said he was reading a book.

usage.text: Past Simple zamonini Past Perfect ga o'tkazish uchun.

example.en: They said they had played tennis.
She said that she was happy.

structure.formula: Subject + said + (that) + Subject + didn't + V1 / hadn't + V3

example.en: He said he didn't like coffee.

tip: Eslatma: Ko'chirma gapdan o'zlashtirma gapga o'tganda zamonlar bitta qadam ortga surilishini unutmang (masalan: Present Past bo'ladi).

name: Say vs. Tell
summary: 'Say' va 'tell' fe'llari 'aytmoq' ma'nosini bildiradi, lekin ulardan keyin keladigan so'zlar turlicha bo'ladi.

usage.text: Say fe'lidan keyin tinglovchi (kimga qaratilgani) ko'rsatilmasa ishlatiladi.
Say fe'lidan keyin odam qo'shmoqchi bo'lsak, 'to' ko'makchisi ishlatiladi.

example.en: She said to me that she was tired.

usage.text: Tell fe'lidan keyin doimo tinglovchi (kimga aytilgani) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yoziladi.

example.en: He said to us that he was busy.

structure.formula: Subject + tell / tells / told + someone + something

example.en: He told us that he was busy.

tip: Eslatma: He told me to'g'ri, lekin He said me noto'g'ri. Say dan keyin 'to' kerak!

name: Pronoun and time-word changes
summary: O'zlashtirma gap tuzganda vaqt va joyni bildiruvchi so'zlar hamda olmoshlar vaziyatga qarab o'zgaradi.

usage.text: Payt so'zlari o'tmishdagi paytga moslab o'zgartiriladi (masalan, bugun - o'sha kuni).

example.en: He said, 'I will go today.' -> He said he would go that day.
example.uz: U 'Bugun boraman' dedi -> U o'sha kuni borishini aytdi.

usage.text: Shaxs olmoshlari gapni kim aytayotganiga qarab moslashtiriladi.

example.en: She said, 'I like my car.' -> She said she liked her car.
example.uz: U 'Mashinamni yoqtiraman' dedi -> U o'z mashinasini yoqtirishini aytdi.

example.en: He said, 'I want this book.' -> He wanted that book.
example.uz: U 'Bu kitobni xohlayman' dedi -> U o'sha kitobni xohlashini aytdi.

structure.formula: today -> that day / now -> then / here -> there

example.en: She said she was busy then.
example.uz: U o'sha paytda band ekanligini aytdi.

structure.formula: yesterday -> the day before / tomorrow -> the next day

example.en: He said he would come the next day.

tip: Eslatma: Agar suhbat o'sha kuni va o'sha joyning o'zida bo'lib o'tayotgan bo'lsa, payt so'zlari o'zgarmasligi ham mumkin.
